scope: GT-only posthoc evaluation of verified positive-volume intersection-ball centers against the original immutable frozen RGBD occupancy and exact selected proxy boxes. Native preexecution and later complete numerical samples are distinguished. Counts are witness/body-obstacle/sample pairs, not independent collisions or a swept-volume fraction. A center in UNKNOWN or mapped FREE does not establish complete causation; selected OCCUPIED centers may indicate planner collision-model coverage limits. No GT reaches planning.
